ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying all charges accrued for Services rendered through the effective date of termination. Customer will not be liable for any early termination charge, penalty, or similar fee, and IBM will refund to Customer, within thirty (30) days after the effective date of termination, any prepaid charges allocable to the period after that date.

input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that a convenience exit must be penalty-free with a pro-rata refund of prepaid charges, so we removed the open-ended early termination charges cross-referenced to Attachment A and added the refund. If a charge is essential, we can accept a cap of three months' charges for the terminated Services as a fallback.
input.summary: Remove uncapped early termination charges from Customer's convenience right and add pro-rata refund of prepaid charges.
